intro: This is Arslantepe, a mound in Malatya province whose story begins in the 6th millennium BC. Within it lies one of the earliest known palaces in the world.
history: Arslantepe's layers record something momentous: the birth of the state and of centralised power. And the swords found here are among the oldest metal swords known.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the 4th-millennium palace, the Lion gate, the Wall paintings and the Protective shelter.
facts: Did you know? Seal impressions found here show how bureaucracy worked before writing was invented. The building of around 3300 BC is among the earliest known palaces in the world: the first architecture of the thing we call a state. The arsenical copper swords found here are counted among the oldest known swords in the world. And in 2021 Arslantepe was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List.
outro: This brings our tour of Arslantepe to an end. Before you go, please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Thank you for walking with us, and enjoy your visit.
